interpretation_ko: 자식이 앓고 사업이 실망스럽게 돌아오며 바라던 즐거운 나들이가 어그러질 조짐
interpretation_en: implies the sickness of children, disappointing returns in business, and failure to make anticipated visits of pleasure

cite.original: Dreaming of seeing or eating peaches, implies the sickness of children, disappointing returns in business, and failure to make anticipated visits of pleasure; but if you see them on trees with foliage, you will secure some desired position or thing after much striving and risking of health and money.
cite.translation_ko: 복숭아를 보거나 먹는 꿈은, 자식이 앓고 사업이 실망스럽게 돌아오며 바라던 즐거운 나들이가 어그러질 조짐이다

context: 잎이 우거진 나무에 달린 복숭아를 봄
interpretation_ko: 건강과 돈을 무릅쓰고 애쓴 끝에 바라던 자리나 것을 얻을 조짐
interpretation_en: you will secure some desired position or thing after much striving and risking of health and money

cite.original: Dreaming of seeing or eating peaches, implies the sickness of children, disappointing returns in business, and failure to make anticipated visits of pleasure; but if you see them on trees with foliage, you will secure some desired position or thing after much striving and risking of health and money.
cite.translation_ko: 잎이 우거진 나무에 달린 복숭아를 보는 꿈은, 건강과 돈을 무릅쓰고 애쓴 끝에 바라던 자리나 것을 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_en: denotes that enemies will steal from you

cite.original: To see dried peaches, denotes that enemies will steal from you.
cite.translation_ko: 마른 복숭아를 보는 꿈은, 적이 저를 등쳐 먹을 조짐이다

context: 처녀가 무성한 나무에서 탐스러운 복숭아를 땀
interpretation_ko: 제 매력과 자질로 재산 많고 세상 물정에 밝은 남편을 얻을 조짐
interpretation_en: she will, by her personal charms and qualifications, win a husband rich in worldly goods and wise in travel

cite.original: For a young woman to dream of gathering luscious peaches from well-filled trees, she will, by her personal charms and qualifications, win a husband rich in worldly goods and wise in travel.
cite.translation_ko: 처녀가 무성한 나무에서 탐스러운 복숭아를 따는 꿈은, 제 매력과 자질로 재산 많고 세상 물정에 밝은 남편을 얻을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 친척에게 박대받고 병으로 매력을 잃을 조짐
interpretation_en: she will meet with unkindness from relatives and ill health will steal away her attractions

cite.original: If the peaches prove to be green and knotty, she will meet with unkindness from relatives and ill health will steal away her attractions.
cite.translation_ko: 복숭아가 설익고 옹이가 지는 꿈은, 친척에게 박대받고 병으로 매력을 잃을 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 기쁨과 재물의 빛나는 흐름 아래 슬픔과 실패가 도사려 작은 자극에도 뒤섞일 조짐
interpretation_en: there lies below the brilliant and flashing ebb and flow of the stream of pleasure and riches, the slums of sorrow and failure, which threaten to mix with its clearness at the least disturbing influence

cite.original: For persons dreaming of peacocks, there lies below the brilliant and flashing ebb and flow of the stream of pleasure and riches, the slums of sorrow and failure, which threaten to mix with its clearness at the least disturbing influence.
cite.translation_ko: 공작 꿈은, 기쁨과 재물의 빛나는 흐름 아래 슬픔과 실패가 도사려 작은 자극에도 뒤섞일 조짐이다

interpretation_ko: 남자의 명예를 잘못 헤아려 속을 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that she will be deceived in her estimate of man's honor

cite.original: For a woman to dream that she owns peacocks, denotes that she will be deceived in her estimate of man's honor.
cite.translation_ko: 여성이 공작을 소유하는 꿈은, 남자의 명예를 잘못 헤아려 속을 조짐이다

context: 공작의 거친 울음소리를 들으며 화려한 깃털을 봄
interpretation_ko: 곱고 훤칠한 이가 저를 불편하고 불안하게 만들 조짐
interpretation_en: denotes that some beautiful and well-appearing person will work you discomfort and uneasiness of mind

cite.original: To hear their harsh voices while looking upon their proudly spread plumage, denotes that some beautiful and well-appearing person will work you discomfort and uneasiness of mind.
cite.translation_ko: 공작의 거친 울음소리를 들으며 화려한 깃털을 보는 꿈은, 곱고 훤칠한 이가 저를 불편하고 불안하게 만들 조짐이다
